_why: Config for the optional guardrails PreToolUse hook (--with-guardrails). Both checks are INERT until you fill these in. No secrets here — only org/account names and pytest flags.

gh_account._why: Block a mutating `gh` command when the repo's origin is one of these orgs but the active gh account is not required_account. Leave placeholders to disable.

pytest_reminder._why: Non-blocking reminder when a pytest run omits flags this codebase tends to need.
